title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) Guidelines
issuing_authority: Mechanization & Technology Division, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
document_text:
SUB-MISSION ON AGRICULTURAL MECHANIZATION (SMAM)
OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES

1. OBJECTIVE: Increasing the reach of farm mechanization to small and marginal farmers and to the regions where availability of farm power is low.

2. FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FOR PROCUREMENT: Financial assistance of 40% to 50% of the cost of machinery or up to the ceiling limit specified, whichever is less, is provided for procurement of agricultural equipment including tractors, power tillers, rotavators, power weeders, and sprayers.

3. SPECIAL PROVISIONS FOR SMALL, MARGINAL AND WOMEN FARMERS: For SC, ST, Small and Marginal Farmers, Women, and beneficiaries of North-Eastern States, financial assistance is 50% of the cost. For other beneficiaries, financial assistance is 40% of the cost.

4. APPLICATION PROCESS: Applications must be submitted online on the DBT Agriculture Machinery portal (agrimachinery.nic.in) with valid Aadhaar, land record (7/12 extract), caste certificate (if applicable), and quotation from an authorized agricultural machinery dealer.

5. DIRECT BENEFIT TRANSFER: The approved subsidy amount is transferred directly to the farmer's bank account via DBT upon physical verification of the machinery by the block agricultural engineer.
